svg.title: Governed Banking Next-Best-Action Architecture on Cloudera on AWS
svg.desc: High-level Cloudera on AWS reference architecture connecting Branch Advisors and Customers through AWS ALB and Knox SSO to the Cloudera AI Workbench Application, LangGraph Multi-Agent System, Cloudera AI Inference Service, CDW Impala Virtual Warehouse, Amazon S3 Apache Iceberg v2 tables, Cloudera DataFlow, and LangSmith Observability.
svg.text: Governed Banking Next-Best-Action on Cloudera on AWS
Advisor Workbench, Portfolio Risk & Profit Analytics, LangGraph MAS, Cloudera AI Inference & CDW Impala Apache Iceberg v2
AWS
AWS Cloud — Cloudera Data Platform (CDP) Public Cloud
AWS Region (e.g., us-east-1)
CDP Environment VPC (Amazon EKS Private Subnets)
Auxiliary Governance
HTTPS / SSO
REST + Charts
Iceberg v2 R/W
/api/events/simulate
OTel Traces & Feedback
End-to-End Architecture Flow
Advisor & Customer SSO Ingress
HTTPS traffic routes via AWS ALB and Cloudera Knox
SSO to the Cloudera AI Application container.
Dual-View Workbench & LangGraph MAS
FastAPI serves the 3-column Advisor Workbench and
Portfolio SVG charts over the LangGraph agentic core.
Cloudera AI Inference & Registry
Invokes Nemotron on GPU nodes (OpenAI API) and
optional ONNX risk models from Cloudera AI Registry.
Governed SQL via CDW Impala VW
Customer 360 dossiers, cohort filters, and 10k-book
analytics run over TLS on a CDW Impala Warehouse.
Apache Iceberg v2 on Amazon S3
ACID Iceberg v2 tables (customers, offers, outcomes)
stored in S3 and governed by Ranger + AWS RAZ.
Real-Time Cloudera DataFlow Events
NiFi flows stream deposit, card-spend, and opt-out
triggers into Iceberg or /api/events/simulate.
LangSmith Tracing & Evaluation
Streams nested turn traces, thread IDs, thumbs
feedback, and offline LLM-as-judge benchmarks.
Solid lines: synchronous request / SQL paths
Dashed lines: async event, telemetry & MLOps promotion
